sv.why.unreachable: The agent on this computer cannot be reached.
sv.why.forbidden: You do not have access to this conversation.

sv.why.closed: This chat is closed, so reopen it first.

sv.why.approver_elsewhere: Approvals for this chat are held by another window.

sv.missing.journal: the record that keeps sends safe
